episodes.title: Edgar
episodes.summary: As time runs out, interrogators turn up the heat on a stone-faced doctor suspected of sexually assaulting and slaying his teenage stepdaughter.

episodes.title: Stacey
episodes.summary: With a shadowy colleague looking on, the team starts poking holes in the evolving story of a combative suspect accused of poisoning her brother-in-law.

episodes.title: Jay
episodes.summary: The team badgers a reticent truck driver to locate an abandoned trailer full of immigrants, but a new interrogator's poor decision jeopardizes it all.

episodes.title: Julia
episodes.summary: Called in one by one on a Sunday, the team risks a legal entanglement when a routine interview with a convicted killer's wife takes a provocative turn.

episodes.title: Alex
episodes.summary: With scarce evidence to guide them, the investigators question an arrogant businessman accused of rape by a woman who works for him.

episodes.title: Danielle
episodes.summary: Asking increasingly pointed questions, the team tries to crack a zealous defense put forth by the head of an online group that unmasks sexual predators.

episodes.title: Sandeep
episodes.summary: Confronted with a shrewd convicted killer wanting to cut a deal, the investigators gamble on calling in a disgraced former colleague to help.
